# Prompts to extend this design system

Use these when asking for more components later.

1. Make a new Kaixu-compatible component using the existing kx-* class system. It must not require a backend.
2. Make a command deck screen using kaixu-tokens.css and kaixu-components.css only.
3. Make a client pitch landing page using this design arsenal and keep all copy client-facing.
4. Make a mobile-first app shell using the kx-phone component pattern.
5. Make a social post HTML card that renders at 1080x1080 and uses the same trippy 3D style.
